target_gate: Phase 7 approve/reject/resume runtime control action endpoints

summary.claim: Runtime approve/reject/resume action endpoints now write canonical OperatorAction audit rows, emit follow-up operator_control session events, return refreshed interrupt snapshots, and best-effort write checkpoint interrupt responses when an interrupt_id is supplied.
summary.rationale: This closes the missing read/write API surface for runtime controls without creating dashboard-only state. It does not claim full production-grade live resume across every runtime transport; A2A strict readiness, memory hardening, and exhaustive provider proof remain incomplete.

Extended tests/test_runtime_graph_api.py to prove operator-level action recording, checkpoint response writing, API endpoint behavior, and route registration.
